map.按首时段、后续计费单位与单日封顶规则计算停车费，支持免费时长与跨天停放，辅助出行: Computes parking charges from the first period, the subsequent billing unit and the daily cap, supporting free allowances and multi-day parking, for trip cost budgeting.
map.免费时长 (分钟，仅首段抵扣): Free time (minutes, deducted from the first period only)
map.停车费 = 首段费 + 超时费；超时分钟 = max(0, 停车时长 − 首段时: Parking fee = first period fee + overtime fee; overtime minutes = max(0, duration − first period − free time); overtime fee = ⌈overtime minutes ÷ billing unit⌉ × unit rate; daily cap applies; multiple days accumulate day by day.
map.首 1 小时免费/半价，消费满额免 1~2 小时: First hour free or half price, 1~2 hours free above a minimum spend
map.满额免时优先，超时按全时长计: Spend-based free time applies first, overtime billed over the whole stay
map.分时段单价，探视时段优惠: Time-of-day rates with discounts for visiting hours
map.按天封顶通常更划算: A daily cap usually works out cheaper
map.首 15~30 分钟免费，长停按日封顶: First 15~30 minutes free, daily cap for long stays
map.长停选远端车场或按日套餐: Choose remote lots or daily packages for long stays
map.夜间免费时段可省整段费用: Free overnight windows can save an entire block of fees
map.封顶是按自然日或单次进场设上限。超过某时长后费用不再累加，因此「分段计费总额 >: A cap sets a ceiling per calendar day or per entry; past a certain duration charges stop accumulating, so once "metered total > cap" you simply pay the cap.
map.绝大多数车场对不足一个计费单位的部分按「进一法」收费，即停 61 分钟按 90: Most lots round any part of a billing unit up, so 61 minutes is charged as 90. This tool applies the same round-up rule.

map.分段计费与封顶: Metered billing and the daily cap
map.首小时 10 元、之后每 30 分钟 5 元、单日封顶 60 元。停 3 小时=: First hour 10 yuan, then 5 yuan per 30 minutes, daily cap 60 yuan. A 3-hour stay costs 10 + 5×4 = 30 yuan; a 10-hour stay hits the cap and pays just 60 yuan, so long stays unit-price lower than short ones.
map.封顶指单个自然日（或一次进场）费用不超过该上限，超过部分不再累加。跨天停放通常每: A cap means one calendar day (or one entry) never exceeds that ceiling; anything beyond stops accumulating. Multi-day parking usually restarts the cap each day.
map.多数商场消费满额免 1–2 小时，短停可借免费时段免单；超时按规则从进场起算，非: Most malls grant 1–2 hours free above a minimum spend, so short stays may cost nothing; once you go over, billing runs from entry rather than from the end of the free window.
map.实际计费以车场公示牌为准，进出场时间与免费规则判定可能存在差异: Actual billing follows the posted signs; recorded entry/exit times and free-time rules may differ
